description: Reads one version of a report the person may read (the newest unless version is given): its title, kind, the version's number, fingerprint, personal-data level and reader floor, and its blocks in order, as the document holds them. Long documents come a page at a time: blockCount says how many blocks there are, and when nextFromBlock is not null, send it as from_block to read the next page with the same version. Read it before you share, edit or summarize a report; edit_report and restore_report_version need its version number.

from_block.description: Counted from 1: the first block to return, the nextFromBlock of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

version.description: The version to read (list_report_versions gives numbers). Leave it out for the newest.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: read_report
title: Read a report's content
